summary: Page thumbnails (NOTES_SPEC §12 / library.md §3), new files only. PageThumbs: lazy pipeline on a shared 'reader-thumbs' BACKGROUND daemon thread; ThumbMap resolution with session.layout (≤3 rounds, idx clamp, counts.globalPage labels); per-generation/paint renderer drawing drawChrome(PageDecor(hl,false,null)) + drawBody on a uniform scale into RGB_565 (thumbnail grey flag < 0.3); one e-ink update per grid page (complete, or partial after 700 ms) / progressive ≥100 ms on phones; directional next-grid-page prefetch; byte-sized LRU (ThumbBudget 8/16 MB, memoryClass/32) keyed by ThumbKey, cleared on generation/paint change, clear() and close(); cancel() re-prefetches curSection±1 after thumbnail layouts. ThumbsTab (PageTarget) + ThumbGridView (single View: bitmaps/placeholders, 3 dp current frame, 12 sp labels, ribbon/❝/✎ marks, PageDrag(axisBoth) swipes, tap→goToPage(remember)+dismiss, numpad go-to, prepare() for a one-update tab switch). InkPager implements the new PageTarget; inkPagerKeys takes () -> PageTarget?.

rcaNotes:
### RCA-3 ReaderActivity: version bumps (main thread)
- wherever `session = s` is assigned — the open path (base ReaderActivity.kt ~L829) AND reopenDocument's TXT re-parse
  (`session = s; … old.close()`, ~L1849): `thumbs?.close(); thumbs = null; decorVersion = IntArray(s.sectionCount)`
  (otherwise PageThumbs keeps the closed old session and the tab stays blank).
- `reloadAnnotations()` runs on every focus regain (each dialog dismiss): bump ONLY the sections whose rows changed —
  before `quotesBySection = map; bookmarks = …`, compare per section old vs new quote ranges (start, end, style), the
  bookmark offsets grouped by section and the set of quote ids with a non-blank note; `bumpDecor(sec)` for each
  differing section (a pure `ThumbDecorDiff`-style helper next to DecorDiff fits). Never a global bump.
- `setHighlights(owner, section, …)`: only in the `owner == OWNER_QUOTES` branch: `bumpDecor(section)` (transient
  owners — TTS, selection, jump, search — must NOT bump it)
- `toggleBookmark()` and every other bookmark add/delete path (incl. the contents dialog's bookmark delete, which ends in
  `reloadAnnotations`): `bumpDecor(sec)` for the bookmark's section
- every `BookSession.Change.REPAINT` (in `applyToSession`, before `repaint()`) and in `applyReaderColors(s)` when the
  colours/invert actually changed: `paintVersion++` (PageThumbs clears its LRU and rebuilds its renderer on a change)
- `QuoteLook.update(...)` flips are covered by the key (`QuoteLook.generation`): nothing to do

### RCA-4 ReaderActivity: memory and close
- C19 trim gate (`onTrimMemory`): `if (low) { session?.trimMemory(); thumbs?.clear() }` (+ `scroll?.onTrimMemory()`
  once RC-A's scroll field exists) with
  `low = level >= TRIM_MEMORY_BACKGROUND || level == TRIM_MEMORY_RUNNING_LOW || level == TRIM_MEMORY_RUNNING_CRITICAL`
- before every `session?.close()` (onDestroy ~L487, closeCurrentBook ~L978) and before reopenDocument's `old.close()`:
  `thumbs?.close(); thumbs = null`
- a new generation needs nothing: PageThumbs clears its LRU when `session.generation.id` changes and drops results of
  an older generation.

### RCA-5 ReaderMenus.showOverflowMenu: the item right after "페이지 이동", hidden in scroll mode
```kotlin
MenuItem("페이지 이동", R.drawable.ic_find_in_page) { guarded { ReaderPanels.showGoTo(this) } },
// W2: hidden in scroll mode (no pages to show)
MenuItem("페이지 썸네일", R.drawable.ic_grid_view) { guarded { ReaderPanels.showContents(this, 3) } },
```
(build the list with `buildList { … if (!scrollModeActive()) add(…) … }` or `listOfNotNull(…, if (scroll) null else MenuItem(…), …)`; C22 order:
페이지 이동 · 페이지 썸네일 · (narrow) 북마크 추가/삭제 · 스크롤로 보기/페이지로 보기 · …)
